name: GRAPH009_SOURCE_ONLY_CALIBRATED_GATE
window_selection: 4 evenly spaced 257-byte windows per FIT chapter; 8 per external Python source file; 256 observed-character contexts; bytes >=128 -> 63.
retrieval: 4-character suffix exact match, latest older known following character strictly before prediction point. Source-only bounded 512-byte ring with explicit owner identity and absolute ordinals; no future labels.
gate: 6-feature, 0.9*sigmoid(w dot feature), hit-only, train 300 steps Adam 0.03 with L2 0.01 on 16 FIT chapters, select epoch on 14 disjoint FIT chapters, frozen base seed 1701, no external tuning.
controls: lambda 0.5 fixed, no cache, FIT-only unigram and same learned gate offered to both GRAPH007 and GRAPH008 5-seed frozen next-only models. Python files external to Vim source, not official protected TEST.
limits: Gate training changes optimization budget and adds parameters; no full model training parity; no authentic owner authentication; source-code shift is not language benchmark generality.
